name: @certen.io/mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for the CERTEN Gateway — read-only by default, and it never holds a signing key

scripts.//prepack: Build AND bundle the docs before packing. Without bundle-docs the published package serves zero resources, because llms.txt and docs/ live outside this package root and npm's `files` cannot reach outside it.
scripts.prepack: npm run bundle-docs && npm run build

//dependencies: The SDK is the only runtime dependency. MCP's stdio transport is newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 — a small, stable surface implemented directly in src/protocol.ts. For a server that can authorize value-bearing operations, every avoided transitive dependency is avoided supply-chain risk.
